name: Mortrini
source:
??? - "flesh golem" - f

Mortrini was cursed many years ago, doomed to a life of constant rotting. To continue functioning, she steals body parts from other living beings, so she's become something of a wanted woman. Ruthless. Manipulative. Quick on her feet and in her wits. Even without eyes, she manages to evade the law.

[From [url=http://pawsalamode.com/cafechan/algormortis/]official site[/url]]
